items.title: Pedagogical Models, Competences, and Tools
items.does: Reviews existing pedagogical approaches, competence models and AI-supported tools, to see how current practice helps or hinders foundational skills and AI competences. It also sets the common study design for the pilots.

items.title: Design & Co-creation of Pedagogical Patterns and Scenarios
items.does: Turns the results of WP1 into pedagogical patterns and classroom scenarios, designed together with teachers, school leaders, students and VET trainers.

items.title: Neuroscientific Evidence on AI-Enhanced Learning
items.does: Studies with EEG and fNIRS how AI in learning tools affects engagement, implicit learning and positive affect, and derives design rules for AI that activates students.

items.title: Pre-test Piloting of AI-Enriched Classroom Scenarios
items.does: The first test of the scenarios: two to three per country in Croatia, Germany and Greece, with about 300 to 360 learners. It checks whether the scenarios and the assessment instruments are feasible and usable.

items.title: EU-wide Piloting of AI-Enriched Classroom Scenarios
items.does: Tests the refined scenarios in Lithuania, Germany, Croatia, Finland, Italy and Greece with about 1,000 learners, before and after, against control groups.

items.title: Analysis and Evaluation of Piloting
items.does: Analyses the pilot data for effects on foundational competences and well-being, within and across countries, and discusses the results with stakeholders in co-evaluation workshops.

items.title: Data Enrichment, Integration, and Exploratory Dashboard
items.does: Brings the pilot data together, harmonises it and adds indicators on the social and urban context. Builds an interactive dashboard for exploring the results.

items.title: Adoption Materials for Schools and Policy Recommendations
items.does: Turns the evidence into toolkits, guides for teachers and school leaders, training modules and micro-credentials, and policy recommendations.

items.title: Communication, Dissemination, and Stakeholder Engagement I (Awareness & Networks)
items.does: Builds the project's visibility and networks in the first half: identity, website, newsletter, events and the Youth Advisory Board. Feedback from schools and stakeholders goes back into the research work.

items.title: Communication, Dissemination, and Stakeholder Engagement II (Adoption & Uptake)
items.does: Moves from awareness to use in the second half: adoption campaigns, an open repository of resources in at least six languages, and policy dialogues.

items.title: Project Management I (Governance, Ethics, Data Setup)
items.does: Sets up governance, quality assurance, risk management, ethics and data protection before the pilots begin.

items.title: Project Management II (Coordination, Ethics Monitoring, Data Lifecycle Completion)
items.does: Coordinates the second half, monitors ethics during the large pilots and completes the data lifecycle.
